title: Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with pressure-relief temple channels and contoured removable cheek pads.

description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue is crafted for daily urban navigators conquering dense traffic. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1296g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~85 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.06 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and a glove-friendly quick-release ratcheting buckle.
yoast_title: Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
introduction: Positioned in Ruroc's Full Face lineup, the Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue brings British engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06, DOT FMVSS 218 track safety.
story:
The Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue represents Ruroc's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~85 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Ruroc Atlas 4.0 Carbon Gloss Blue delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
